recent_articles.title: Delhi HC seeks response from AAP’s Gopal Rai, journalist in contempt plea - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Gopal Rai**, an AAP leader, and journalist **Saurav Das** were issued notices by the **Delhi High Court** in response to a petition seeking contempt proceedings against them for allegedly orchestrating a social media campaign against Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma. The petition also named former Chief Minister **Arvind Kejriwal** and ex-AAP MLA **Saurabh Bhardwaj** as parties, alleging that they exerted extra-judicial pressure on the judge through their social media posts.  The court has listed the case for further hearing on August 4th after observing that a contempt case is already underway against **Kejriwal** and others.

recent_articles.title: Three die in ‘horrific’ south Sydney vehicle crash after police welfare check | Sydney | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **man** died in a crash in Sydney after fleeing from police who had been called to carry out a welfare check. The crash involved a white Audi that rolled over a barrier and struck a blue Toyota sedan, killing the **man**, the driver of the Toyota, and a passenger.  Police believe the Audi was traveling at "considerable speed" when the crash occurred. Investigations are continuing into the circumstances surrounding the incident.

recent_articles.title: Pakistan gets its own ‘Cockroach Awaam Party’ as India’s viral CJP sparks cross-border satire wave - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pakistan** has seen the emergence of satirical political groups inspired by the **Cockroach Janta Party**, a viral movement in India.  These groups, such as the **Cockroach Awami Party** and **Cockroach Awami League**, have emerged on social media platforms like Instagram and X, mirroring the Indian party's focus on issues affecting unemployed youth, including education, healthcare, and employment opportunities. The Pakistani groups use similar slogans and branding to their Indian counterparts, positioning themselves as alternative voices to mainstream political parties in Pakistan.

recent_articles.title: Voter confusion fears over simultaneous polls ‘misplaced’, says ONOE JPC chairman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P.P. Chaudhary**, chairman of the Joint Parliamentary Committee on ‘One Nation One Election’, defended the proposal, arguing that Indian voters are politically astute and can differentiate between national and state issues.  He cited examples from Delhi and other states where voters supported different parties in Lok Sabha and Assembly elections. **CII**, **ASSOCHAM**, and **GCCI** backed the proposal, while **Gujarat University Vice-Chancellor Dr. Neerja Gupta** highlighted how frequent polls disrupt academic schedules and increase financial costs. The committee also heard concerns from the **Congress**, which argued that simultaneous elections would allow national narratives to overshadow state issues.

recent_articles.title: Parody Cockroach Janta political party’s rise reflects youth anger in India | India | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A satirical online movement, the Cockroach Janta (People's) party, has gained significant traction in India.  **Abhijeet Dipke**, a political communications strategist and student at Boston University, founded the movement after **Surya Kant**, the Supreme Court chief justice, sparked backlash with comments comparing unemployed young people to cockroaches. The CJP uses absurdist humor to mock corruption, joblessness, and government dysfunction, attracting millions of followers on social media.  While some dismiss it as a digital gimmick, Dipke believes it reflects mounting frustration among India's youth and could lead to real political change.

recent_articles.title: Australia news live: Penny Wong rebukes Israel over ‘shocking and unacceptable’ treatment of flotilla activists | Australia news | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Penny Wong**, Australia's foreign affairs minister, condemned the actions of **Itamar Ben-Gvir**, Israel’s far-right national security minister, who posted a video of himself abusing bound activists captured during an aid flotilla to Gaza.  Wong joined international condemnation of the footage and called for the release of the detained Australians and for Israel to ensure no ill treatment of any detainees. The Australian Bureau of Statistics will release its latest figures on the country’s jobless rate today, which could impact future Reserve Bank decisions regarding interest rates.

recent_articles.title: Four-year-old boy rescued after falling into borewell in Punjab’s Hoshiarpur - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A four-year-old boy, Gurkaran Singh, was rescued after nine hours of an intense operation involving multiple agencies in Punjab's Hoshiarpur district. The incident occurred on Friday night when the child fell into a newly dug borewell at Chak Samana village.  **Deputy Commissioner Aashika Jain**, **Punjab Minister Ravjot Singh**, and **AAP MP Raj Kumar Chabbewal** were present during the operation, which involved teams from the NDRF, SDRF, Punjab Police, fire brigade personnel, and local volunteers. The rescue team created a narrow tunnel to reach the child, who was stabilized after being pulled out of the borewell.  The child's family expressed gratitude to all those involved in the successful rescue.

recent_articles.title: AAP, Congress raises concern over SIR in Punjab ahead of 2027 Assembly polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** issued a notification for a Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Punjab and other states, prompting concerns from the **Indian National Congress** and the **Aam Aadmi Party**. The SIR exercise will involve door-to-door visits by both-level officers (BLOs) from June 25 to July 24, 2026.  The **AAP** alleged that constitutional institutions under the **BJP** rule are being misused for political advantage, while the **Congress** expressed concerns about the timing of the exercise ahead of the upcoming Punjab assembly elections. The **Haryana Chief Electoral Officer** announced a similar SIR campaign in Haryana with a qualifying date of July 1, 2026.

recent_articles.title: Opposition parties are spreading panic over PM’s voluntary, precautionary appeal: BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** criticized opposition parties, accusing them of spreading misinformation about Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**’s call for voluntary gold purchases and foreign travel restrictions.  **BJP spokesperson Gaurav Bhatia** stated that the government has taken measures to protect India's economy and there is no shortage of essential commodities.

recent_articles.title: ​Split wide open: On the AIADMK, Tamil Nadu politics - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **AIADMK**, the principal opposition party in Tamil Nadu, is facing a split after a second consecutive election defeat.  **C. Joseph Vijay**, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, has indicated his support for the dissident group led by former Ministers **C.Ve. Shanmugam** and **S.P. Velumani**. The dissidents have announced their intention to support the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) government.  The Palaniswami camp claims that all 47 legislators gave written consent for **Edappadi K. Palaniswami** as the AIADMK legislature party leader, citing a Supreme Court verdict in the Shiv Sena case. The Assembly Speaker will need to assess the merits of both groups' claims and may soon have to draw on his experience and legal advice.

recent_articles.title: Crumbling of Awadh’s heritage amidst monument encroachments - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A report by the Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) highlights the concerning state of protected monuments in Uttar Pradesh. The report found that 31 centrally protected monuments are untraceable, with only 31 monuments having proper ownership documentation and 96 being encroached upon. Heritage activists express worry over the disappearance of these historical sites and the potential loss of Awadhi culture, which is intertwined with the architecture and traditions of these structures.  The report also found that the ASI has not been adequately enforcing existing laws and regulations, leading to inadequate planning and documentation for conservation efforts. Experts advocate for stronger legislation, including a state heritage law, to address this issue and protect these valuable cultural assets.

recent_articles.title: AAP holds protests against BJP over ED action against Punjab Minister Sanjeev Arora - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** held protests across Punjab against the **BJP** following the ED's arrest of Punjab Industries Minister Sanjeev Arora on charges of GST fraud. The protests, led by AAP leaders including Hardip Singh Mundian and Mohinder Bhagat, escalated into clashes with BJP workers in Ludhiana and Bathinda.  The **BJP** accused AAP workers of attacking their activists while the **AAP** condemned the police's alleged inaction.

recent_articles.title: ED gets seven-day custody of Punjab Minister Sanjeev Arora - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** secured seven-day custody of **Sanjeev Arora**, the Industries Minister in the **Aam Aadmi Party** government in Punjab, in connection with an alleged money-laundering case.  **Arora** was arrested after being produced before a Gurugram special court on Saturday, May 9, 2026. The case stems from an inquiry into suspected violations of the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA) by **Hampton Sky Realty Limited (HSRL)** where **Arora** previously served as chairman and managing director (CMD).

recent_articles.title: Punjab Congress to release ‘chargesheet’ against AAP government - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bhupesh Baghel**, former **Chhattisgarh** Chief Minister and Congress General Secretary in charge of Punjab, presided over a meeting of the state party unit to discuss the "grim state of affairs" under the ruling **AAP** government. The meeting focused on allegations of rampant corruption and deteriorating law and order, leading to feelings of insecurity among residents.  The **Congress** plans to hold "yatras" across all 117 Assembly segments in the coming days to engage with voters and address their concerns.

recent_articles.title: Kejriwal slams PM Modi over ED raids in Punjab - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **AAP** leader Arvind Kejriwal accused the **ED** of being a tool for political intimidation, targeting Punjab Minister Sanjeev Arora in raids.  Kejriwal claimed that the BJP is trying to break AAP leaders and force them into joining their party, comparing PM Modi's actions to Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb's atrocities. He asserted that the people of Punjab will resist these attacks and teach the BJP a lesson in the 2027 Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: Punjab worse than West Bengal under AAP rule, says Haryana CM Saini - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** criticized the **AAP government in Punjab**, accusing it of failing to control drug trafficking, illegal mining, and lawlessness. He compared the current situation in Punjab to West Bengal under **Mamata Banerjee**, stating that people are disillusioned with the AAP and seeking change through the BJP's governance model.  Saini also contrasted the BJP's policies with those of the Congress, highlighting the latter's corruption and lack of focus on people's welfare.

recent_articles.title: ‘They came to kill us’: royal commission hears horrific accounts of antisemitism faced by Jewish children in Australia | Royal commission on antisemitism and social cohesion | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Jewish** children in Australia are facing increasing antisemitic abuse, including swastikas and Nazi salutes, at school. **Dina**, a Jewish mother who testified before the royal commission, stated that her children live with this reality "all day, every day" and fear for their safety.  **Natalie Levy**, another parent, shared similar experiences of her daughter witnessing antisemitic graffiti and online rhetoric, describing it as "normalised" in contemporary Australia. **AAP**, a Jewish mother from Victoria, reported her children being bombarded with antisemitic content and fearing for their safety at events organized by the Jewish community.  The royal commission is investigating the impact of antisemitism on Jewish Australians after the December Bondi massacre.

recent_articles.title: BJP’s Bengal sweep fires up Punjab unit; AAP moves to deflate buzz - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **BJP**'s strong performance in West Bengal, Assam, and Puducherry has fueled hopes for a similar outcome in Punjab, where elections are scheduled soon.  The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** responded by asserting that the BJP's prospects in Punjab are bleak.  **Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann** criticized the BJP's track record in Punjab, highlighting past injustices and farm law protests as evidence of their unpardonable sins.

recent_articles.title: Saini urges Punjab OBCs to back BJP in Assembly polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** urged the OBC community in Punjab to unite and support the **BJP** in the upcoming Assembly elections. He claimed that the party ensures equal representation and criticized the Aam Aadmi Party government's performance, citing disillusionment with poll promises.  Saini highlighted the community's contributions to nation-building and alleged they have been denied opportunities in Punjab. He urged them to support the BJP, referencing measures under Prime Minister Narendra Modi for OBC representation, reservation in education, and constitutional status for the OBC Commission.

recent_articles.title: Prohibitory orders imposed in Doda as AAP MLA returns home district after 8 months in jail - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Doda District Magistrate Krishan Lal** issued an order barring all assemblies in Doda for two months, citing concerns about potential demonstrations and public disorder. The decision follows the **Jammu and Kashmir High Court's** recent ruling to quash the detention of **AAP legislator Mehraj Malik**.  The order invokes Section 163 of the **Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)** which limits gatherings to four or fewer individuals.

recent_articles.title: Prohibitory orders imposed in Doda as AAP MLA returns home district after 8 months in jail - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Doda District Magistrate Krishan Lal** issued an order barring all assemblies in Doda for two months, citing concerns about potential demonstrations and public disorder. This decision follows the **Jammu and Kashmir High Court's** recent ruling to quash the detention of **AAP's Doda legislator Mehraj Malik**. The order invokes Section 163 of the **Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)**, which restricts gatherings exceeding four individuals.

recent_articles.title: AAP leader alleges threat to life from Byrathi Basavaraj - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sathyavani**, president of the **AAP’s Vignana Nagar ward**, filed a complaint with the Bengaluru Police Commissioner alleging threats to her life and vandalism of her car by local BJP leaders, including **Byrathi Basavaraj**, an MLA.  She claims these actions are politically motivated as she prepares for upcoming elections. The police registered a case after intervention from the **Karnataka Lokayukta**.

recent_articles.title: BJP accuses Trinamool of misusing judicial process out of political desperation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** declined to intervene in a Calcutta High Court decision regarding the deployment of central government officials for vote counting in West Bengal, prompting accusations from the **BJP** that the **Trinamool Congress** was using the judicial process for political gain.  **BJP** spokesperson Sudhanshu Trivedi claimed the **Trinamool Congress** was resorting to desperate measures due to anxiety about a violence-free election in the state. He also criticized the actions of West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, alleging she did not trust her own government employees and staff.

recent_articles.title: High drama in Punjab Assembly; Congress, Akali Dal allege CM Mann was drunk during House proceedings - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Opposition parties in Punjab, including the Congress and Shiromani Akali Dal, have accused **Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann** of appearing intoxicated during a session of the Vidhan Sabha.  They demanded an alcohol test and called for dope testing of all MLAs.  Congress leader Sukhpal Singh Khaira urged **Arvind Kejriwal**, the national convener of the Aam Aadmi Party, to take action against **Mann**. Rajya Sabha MP Swati Maliwal also accused **Mann** of being intoxicated at public events and demanded an alcohol test. The Congress Legislative Party has formally written to the Speaker requesting immediate alco-meter and dope testing of all members.  Finance Minister Harpal Singh Cheema refuted the allegations, calling them false and baseless.
